notes.title: v1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]New Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added level sort
[*] Added offset to the Misc. Options menu
[*] Added a 'Finger' color scheme option
[*] Added a 'Music Speed' option which allows players to adjust the speed of the music in Free Play
[/list]   
[h2]Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where beat gridlines would disappear in Practice Mode
[*] Fixed a crash that would happen on Windows after alt-tabbing
[*] Temporarily disabled 'true' fullscreen (as opposed to borderless) for windows builds. This was causing a black screen for some Windows 11 users on startup 
[/list]

Thanks to everyone who's played Typing Tempo so far! Look forward to more updates in the future~

notes.title: Typing Tempo challenges you in a 41-key typing rhythm game
notes.content:
If you enjoy rhythm games and think you're a master typist, you may want to take a little look over at the new release of Typing Tempo.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2023/05/typing-tempo-challenges-you-in-a-41-key-typing-rhythm-game

notes.title: Typechart Studio - A Chart Editor
notes.content:
Hello typists! Hope you are all enjoying "Typing Tempo" thus far! I wanted to post a quick announcement to share how to access the level editor, as I realize that it may not be so obvious at first.

"Typechart Studio," a chart editor for the game can be found under the "Steam Tools" section of your Steam library. If you have purchased Typing Tempo, it should have automatically been downloaded as well. In your Steam Library, on the left drop-down, make sure that 'Tools' is checked:

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43734242/4221e4fd845d48a258108d319b88817cfd411599.png[/img]

Then, searching for "Typechart Studio" should show the editor as one of the programs you can launch. I've written up a quick guide on how to use the tool [url=https://github.com/vsieplus/typechart-studio/wiki]here[/url].

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43734242/fae1223f3c3a0cb9aefae1a06deddd2d08434451.png[/img]

Have fun!
